label.description: A short human label for history and logs, e.g. "Add 3 ledges".

base.description: The sceneHash of the document these ops were written against. Required when any op uses a `~` bulk reference; a mismatch fails with `stale-base`. Batches that use only ids apply without it.

actor.description: Who made the edit: "human", "agent", or an agent's name.

type.description: The entity's registered type. The remaining fields depend on it, as in the scene schema.

id.description: Optional. Without one the id is generated as `<type>-<n>` with the lowest free n and returned in `created`. Pass your own id to refer to the entity later in the same batch.

entity.description: An entity as in the scene file, with `id` optional and `shape` accepting any shape form. A type with a `path` has its `shape` local to the path point; every other position is absolute.

index.description: Insert at this position instead of appending. Used by inverse batches to restore an entry where it was.

oneOf.description: Add one entity to `entities`.

key.description: A bulk key whose entries are shapes.

anyOf.description: A shape tuple: ["box", cx, cy, hw, hh, rotDeg?], ["circle", cx, cy, r], ["capsule", cx, cy, halfLen, r, rotDeg?], ["poly", x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, ...] (convex) or ["chain", x1, y1, ..., xn, yn] (static polyline). Box and capsule sizes are half-extents. Integer pixels, integer degrees, y down.

type.description: box, circle, capsule, poly, chain or rect.

anyOf.description: A shape object with named fields, or `{ type: "rect", left, top, right, bottom }` for a box given by its edges (width and height must be even so the half-extents are integers).

items.description: A shape in any accepted form. It is checked when the op applies and stored as a tuple.

shapes.description: Shapes to append, in order. Absolute world pixels.

index.description: Insert at this position instead of appending. Used by inverse batches to restore an entry where it was.

oneOf.description: Add id-less shapes to a bulk array.

ref.description: An entity id such as `lift`, or a bulk reference `~<bulkKey>:<index>` such as `~solid:3` or `~solid:ice:0`. Bulk references shift when an earlier entry is removed, so a batch that uses one must carry `base`. All references in a batch resolve against the document the batch started from.

set.description: Field path to new value, e.g. `{ "path.speed": 140 }` or `{ "shape": ["box", 0, 0, 40, 6] }`. Paths are dot-separated, with numeric segments for array items (`path.pts.1`); missing objects on the way are created. On a bulk reference only its bulk field (`shape`, or `at` for a point bulk key) can be set. `id` and `type` can't be set: use rename, or remove and add.

unset.description: Field paths to delete. An array item is spliced out.

oneOf.description: Change fields of one entity. The result is checked against its type's schema.

items.description: An entity id such as `lift`, or a bulk reference `~<bulkKey>:<index>` such as `~solid:3` or `~solid:ice:0`. Bulk references shift when an earlier entry is removed, so a batch that uses one must carry `base`. All references in a batch resolve against the document the batch started from.

prefixItems.description: y in world pixels; y is down.

by.description: The offset [dx, dy] in integer pixels; positive dy moves down.

oneOf.description: Translate entities. An entity with a `path` moves its path points (its shape stays local to them); a point entity moves `at`; everything else moves its `shape`.

ref.description: An entity id such as `lift`, or a bulk reference `~<bulkKey>:<index>` such as `~solid:3` or `~solid:ice:0`. Bulk references shift when an earlier entry is removed, so a batch that uses one must carry `base`. All references in a batch resolve against the document the batch started from.

prefixItems.description: y in world pixels; y is down.

at.description: Where the chosen spot of the shape should end up.

anchor.description: Which spot of the shape's bounding box lands on `at`: `center` (default), or the middle of the `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right` edge. `top` puts the top edge at y without knowing the half-height. Point entities ignore it.

oneOf.description: Move one entity so a spot of its bounding box lands on a point.

items.description: An entity id such as `lift`, or a bulk reference `~<bulkKey>:<index>` such as `~solid:3` or `~solid:ice:0`. Bulk references shift when an earlier entry is removed, so a batch that uses one must carry `base`. All references in a batch resolve against the document the batch started from.

oneOf.description: Remove entities or bulk entries.

to.description: The new id; must be free.

oneOf.description: Change an entity's id and rewrite every reference to it.

id.description: The id the new entity gets; must be free.

oneOf.description: Turn a bulk entry into an entity with an id, keeping its type and material, so it can be referenced without `base`.

id.description: An entity of a type with a bulk form, with no fields beyond what a bulk entry holds.

oneOf.description: Turn an entity back into an id-less bulk entry, appended to its bulk array.

bounds.description: The scene's playable area as [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] in integer world pixels; y is down.

oneOf.description: Change the scene's name or bounds.

set.description: Settings path to new value, e.g. `{ "gravity": [0, 900] }`. Dot-separated like update's `set`. Settings fields: `gravity`, `physics`, `grid`, `view`.

unset.description: Settings paths to delete, back to their defaults.

oneOf.description: Change the scene's settings. The result is checked against the settings schema.

items.description: An entity id such as `lift`, or a bulk reference `~<bulkKey>:<index>` such as `~solid:3` or `~solid:ice:0`. Bulk references shift when an earlier entry is removed, so a batch that uses one must carry `base`. All references in a batch resolve against the document the batch started from.

refs.description: Entities, or instances (not both), in the order they should end up.

index.description: Where they go in their list (`entities` or `instances`), counted without them: 0 puts them first. Order is draw order within a layer.

oneOf.description: Move entities or instances to a new place in their list, keeping their order.

prefixItems.description: y in world pixels; y is down.

rot.description: Quarter turns clockwise (y down); omitted is 0.

flip.description: Mirror x in the prefab's frame, before `rot`.

z.description: Draw order within the layer, an integer in [-10000, 10000]; higher draws on top. On an instance it is added to every child's z.

params.description: Values of the prefab's exposed parameters, by name.

instance.description: An instance as in the scene file: `prefab`, `at`, and optionally `id`, `rot`, `flip`, `z`, `params`, `overrides`, `name`, `layer`, `group`, `off`.

index.description: Insert at this position instead of appending. Used by inverse batches to restore an entry where it was.

oneOf.description: Place a prefab: add one instance to `instances`.

id.description: The group's id; a new id declares a group (at [0, 0] unless `at` says).

at.description: The group's origin. Members store geometry relative to it, so changing it moves every member.

prefixItems.description: y in world pixels; y is down.

rot.description: Quarter turns clockwise (y down), absolute; 0 is written as absent.

flip.description: Mirror x before turning, absolute; false is written as absent.

remove.description: Delete the group's declaration; refused while an entity or instance is in it.

oneOf.description: Declare a group, move its origin, rename it, or delete it.

propertyNames.description: An override key: a child's id in the prefab (or `~<bulkKey>:<index>` for a bulk child), a dot, then a field path, e.g. `door.path.speed`.

set.description: Override key to value, in the prefab's own frame (before the instance's `at`): `{ "door.path.speed": 140 }`. Replaces any override of the same field or inside it.

oneOf.description: Set fields of one instance's children that differ from the prefab.

paths.description: Override keys to drop, with any inside them; omitted drops every override.

items.description: An override key: a child's id in the prefab (or `~<bulkKey>:<index>` for a bulk child), a dot, then a field path, e.g. `door.path.speed`.

oneOf.description: Put an instance's children back to the prefab's values.

ref.description: The instance whose overrides become the prefab's.

paths.description: Which overrides to apply; omitted applies all of them.

items.description: An override key: a child's id in the prefab (or `~<bulkKey>:<index>` for a bulk child), a dot, then a field path, e.g. `door.path.speed`.

to.description: The prefab in the instance's chain that receives the values; omitted, the instance's own prefab.

oneOf.description: Write an instance's overrides into its prefab, so every instance of it changes, and drop them from the instance.

at.description: The prefab's origin in world px; omitted, the top-left of the entries' box.

instance.description: The id of the instance that replaces them; omitted, `<id>-<n>`.

entities.description: Entities as in a scene, around the origin.

bulk.description: Bulk entries by bulk key, around the origin.

contract.description: The game's contract for the prefab.

instances.description: Nested instances as in a scene, around the origin.

overrides.description: A variant's overrides of its base's children.

groups.description: Groups to turn or flip, by id.
